title: Preface
author: Francis Bacon
source: *Novum Organum*, Preface, in the English translation edited by Joseph Devey (New York: P. F. Collier & Son, 1902), 5–10. Bacon published the *Novum Organum* in Latin in 1620.
summary: Bacon steers between the dogmatists, who treat nature as already known, and the sceptics, who hold that nothing can be known. He offers neither a rival system nor a contest with the ancients but a new road for the mind, setting apart the anticipation of the mind, which serves for disputation, from the interpretation of nature, which serves for discovery.
